subject: How do I update our team's billing address?
body: Hi support, we recently moved offices. Where in the dashboard can I change the company billing address for our monthly PDF receipts?

subject: Strange issue
body: It isn't working right. Fix it please.

subject: EMERGENCY: Production database non-responsive across all regions

subject: Locked out after changing phones - 2FA reset

subject: Feature Request: Export analytics data to CSV / Excel
body: We love the new dashboard reports, but our finance team needs to export raw weekly metrics to CSV or XLS. Is there a roadmap for adding a direct export button?

subject: Charged twice on invoice #INV-9921

subject: API 403 Forbidden after automated card renewal
body: Our production webhooks stopped firing right after our monthly renewal processed this morning. The console shows HTTP 403 Forbidden on endpoint /v2/events, but our billing status says Active. Needs urgent check.

subject: Cancel subscription and change background color
